build.buildCommand: /mise/shims/python -m pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel && /mise/shims/python -m pip install .

deploy.startCommand: sh -lc 'echo "PORT=$PORT"; if command -v python >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec python -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port "$PORT"; else exec /mise/shims/python -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port "$PORT"; fi'
